chunks: Abu Abdillah al-Asimiy, from Ali ibn al-Hasan al-Mithami, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from his father Asbaat ibn Salim, from Salim, the mawla of Aban, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no bird that is hunted except by its neglecting the glorification (tasbih), and there is no wealth that is lost/wasted except by its neglecting the zakat.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of neglecting zakat according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a metaphysical link between spiritual remembrance and material preservation, illustrating that neglecting the specific duty of zakat leads to the depletion of wealth just as a bird's capture is tied to its failure in glorification. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of zakat not merely as a tax, but as a spiritual mechanism for purifying assets and preventing their loss through divine decree.
